responsibility: This file provides the shared infrastructure used by many gen* programs that consume machine descriptions. It owns common .md reading setup, insn queueing and transformation support, condition tracking and evaluation, predicate-table construction, overloaded pattern bookkeeping, implicit PARALLEL creation, pattern statistics, optab-name matching, and helper analyses for emit/recognition generation, serving as the central library layer that higher-level generators build on when interpreting and rewriting RTL machine-description data.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of the shared machine-description support library for gen* programs: it contains the executable logic for queueing and transforming define_* RTL, condition and predicate handling, pattern statistics, emit-helper selection, and optab-name matching. Unlike gcc/gensupport.h, which exposes declarations and metadata types, this .cc file provides the actual algorithms and data tables.
